title: RashidaAi: AI Made Easy Bootcamp landing page with waitlist, countdown, syllabus, FAQ, and chatbot

requirements.text: Build a clean, modern, fully responsive landing page for “RashidaAi: AI Made Easy Bootcamp” using a vibrant turquoise + hot pink + purple color palette, with clear sectioning and strong calls-to-action for joining the waitlist.

quotes: Create a landing page for RashidaAi: Ai Made Easy Bootcamp Learning course ... and a clean modern responsive design. Colors: turquoise hot pinkish purplish

acceptanceCriteria: Landing page renders correctly on mobile, tablet, and desktop without horizontal scrolling.
Typography, buttons, and section styling consistently reflect a turquoise/hot pink/purple palette (no blue/purple default theme).
Page includes a prominent “Join the waitlist” CTA near the top and again near the bottom.
All user-facing text is in English.

requirements.text: Add a Waitlist signup form that allows visitors to enter and submit their information for the Feb 14, 2026 4-week bootcamp waitlist.

quotes: just give the option to get on the waitlist for the February 14th  2026 4 Week Bootcamp, include an option for them to add and submit their info

acceptanceCriteria: Frontend form includes at least: full name and email (and may include optional fields like goals/experience).
Form validates required fields and shows clear success/failure messages.
On submit, the app calls a backend method to store the waitlist entry.
Duplicate submissions for the same email are handled gracefully (either prevented or updated) with a user-friendly message.

requirements.text: Implement backend storage and APIs for waitlist entries in the single Motoko main actor, including methods to create a waitlist entry and to prevent/handle duplicate emails.

quotes: include an option for them to add and submit their info

acceptanceCriteria: A Motoko type/model exists for waitlist entries and is stored in stable state within the single main actor.
A public update method exists to create/record a waitlist submission.
Duplicate email behavior is deterministic and tested via manual flow (e.g., same email twice returns a clear result).

requirements.text: Add an enrollment countdown timer that counts down to February 14, 2026, displaying days/hours/minutes/seconds and handling the event-started state gracefully.
acceptanceCriteria: Countdown targets Feb 14, 2026 and updates at least once per second.
UI displays a clear label (e.g., “Cohort starts in”) and numeric time units.
When the date/time has passed, UI switches to a sensible state (e.g., “Enrollment closed / Cohort started” or “Join the next waitlist”).

requirements.text: Create a Syllabus section that presents the bootcamp curriculum clearly (e.g., week-by-week for a 4-week program), with scannable headings and bullet points.
acceptanceCriteria: Syllabus is shown as a 4-week structure with headings for Week 1–Week 4.
Content is readable on mobile (no dense multi-column layouts that break).
Syllabus section is reachable via page scrolling and/or an in-page navigation link.

requirements.text: Add an “interactive preview” component for the course (e.g., clickable tabs/cards per week that reveal sample lesson details) without requiring external services.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can interact (click/tap) to switch between preview items (e.g., weeks/modules) and see details update without page reload.
Preview is keyboard accessible (tab focus + enter/space) and works on mobile touch.
Preview content is visually distinct from the main syllabus (e.g., “Sample lesson preview” panel).

requirements.text: Add an FAQ accordion section with multiple questions and expandable answers.
acceptanceCriteria: FAQ items expand/collapse individually with smooth, accessible behavior.
Accordion supports keyboard navigation and has clear open/closed indicators.
FAQ content is in English and aligned with a bootcamp waitlist context (date, length, who it’s for, etc.).

requirements.text: Include a chatbot widget on the landing page that can answer common bootcamp questions using a local scripted flow (no external LLM/API calls), and can direct users to the waitlist form.
acceptanceCriteria: Chat widget can be opened/closed and does not obstruct key content on mobile.
Chatbot provides useful responses for a small set of predefined intents (e.g., dates, duration, pricing/unknown, prerequisites, how to join waitlist).
Chatbot includes a clear action to “Join the waitlist” (scrolls to or opens the form).
No third-party AI/LLM service integration is required for the chatbot to function.

requirements.text: Add generated brand visuals as static assets and use them on the landing page (hero/branding area and/or favicon), stored under frontend/public/assets/generated.

quotes: clean modern responsive design. Colors: turquoise hot pinkish purplish

acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are committed under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced directly by the frontend (not served through the backend).
At least one generated visual is used in the hero area (background/illustration) and one small logo/icon is used in the header and/or favicon.
Images match the turquoise/hot pink/purple aesthetic and look clean/modern.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Do not rely on external databases or third-party authentication providers (Internet Identity only if authentication becomes necessary, but it is not required for the waitlist).
nonGoals: Do not integrate Claude Sonnet 4.5, Emergent, or any external LLM/chat API services.
Do not implement payments, checkout, or paid enrollment flows (waitlist only).
Do not build real-time chat or websocket-based features.
Do not implement a full admin dashboard unless explicitly requested later.

required: Abstract vibrant gradient hero background with subtle geometric shapes in turquoise, hot pink, and purple (rashidaai-hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
Minimal modern logo mark for “RashidaAi” using turquoise/hot pink/purple on transparent background (rashidaai-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Simple chatbot icon button graphic in the same palette on transparent background (rashidaai-chat-icon.dim_256x256.png)
Favicon version of the logo mark, high contrast and readable at small sizes (rashidaai-favicon.dim_64x64.png)
